decisions.evidence: R1 maker presents Add/edit/delete flow with no auto-metadata; R1 client observes the running app: 'when I click "Add bookmark" and paste a link, I still have to type the title myself, and it won't save unless I do' and requests 'make it so that pasting a URL pulls in the page's title and description automatically (I can still tweak them before saving)'. R2 maker: 'Implemented automatic bookmark metadata fetching ... Both fields remain editable'; R2 client: 'That's exactly what I was after.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Divergence established independently by client's factual observation that the presented app requires manual title (REF-BM-02 auto-collect absent). Client supplies the reference-conforming behaviour (auto-fetch title+description, still editable = REF-BM-03), a corrective/correct. Resolved by revised R2 presentation; counted once, disposition folded here (no double count).
